solution:

1) For 'Z' element :

 
• Shifting in the clockwise direction.
 
• No element is repeated more than twice subsequently, thus new elements ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a07c66ad0d07245153f08ddde96c32e232fd387b0be41a589f54b5a054dd52a0.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd66bc95097058bbeb102ccebf76f4620e64a5010acb828468dc6d5553b5efd4.png] ' are introduced likewise.
